hotline.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
hotline.description: Support, safety planning and referrals for relationship abuse.
hotline.linkLabel: Talk to an advocate or find support
hotline.detail: Free support, 24/7. Message and data rates may apply.

loveisrespect.name: love is respect
loveisrespect.description: Relationship and dating abuse support for young people.

988.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
988.description: Talk with a counselor about emotional distress, suicidal thoughts, or mental health and substance use concerns.

crisis-text.name: Crisis Text Line
crisis-text.description: Text with a trained volunteer crisis counselor.
crisis-text.detail: Free service, 24/7. Message and data rates may apply.

nami.name: NAMI HelpLine
nami.description: Mental health information, peer support and referrals. Not a crisis line.

unemployment.name: Unemployment benefits
unemployment.description: Find the official application and eligibility information for the state where you worked.
unemployment.detail: Eligibility and application rules vary by state.

job-centers.name: American Job Centers
job-centers.description: Find local job-search help and employment or training services.
job-centers.detail: Ask the center which services it offers before visiting.

career.name: CareerOneStop
career.description: Job-search tools, career information and training resources.
career.detail: Training programs have their own costs and eligibility.

nfcc.name: NFCC credit counseling
nfcc.description: Connect with a nonprofit credit counselor to discuss debt and budgeting.
nfcc.detail: Free and low-cost services. Ask about fees before agreeing to a plan.

cfpb.name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
cfpb.description: Submit a complaint about a financial product or service.
cfpb.detail: A complaint is not a promise of reimbursement or immediate financial help.

hud.name: HUD housing counseling
hud.description: Find a HUD-participating counselor for housing problems.
hud.detail: Foreclosure, eviction and homelessness counseling is free. Other counseling may have fees.

shelter.name: HUD Find Shelter
shelter.description: Look for nearby shelter, housing, food and clothing resources.
shelter.detail: Contact the provider to confirm hours, eligibility and availability.

food.name: Feeding America
food.description: Find a local food bank that can connect you with pantries and meal programs.
food.linkLabel: Find a food bank near you
food.detail: Check where food is distributed and the current opening hours before going.

snap.name: SNAP food benefits
snap.description: See eligibility information and how to apply through your state.
snap.detail: Eligibility depends on household circumstances and current program rules.

wic.name: WIC
wic.description: Food and nutrition support for eligible pregnant or postpartum people, infants and children under five.
wic.detail: Your local WIC program determines eligibility.

hrsa.name: Community health centers
hrsa.description: Find a health center for care with or without insurance.
hrsa.detail: Sliding-scale fees; care is not necessarily free.

rx.name: RxAssist prescription assistance
rx.description: Look up patient assistance programs for prescription medicines.
rx.detail: Each program sets its own eligibility and assistance rules.

medicare.name: Medicare
medicare.description: Official help with Medicare coverage, billing and claims.
medicare.detail: Insurance costs and coverage vary. This is separate from Medicaid.

medicaid.name: Medicaid & CHIP
medicaid.description: Find your state agency to ask about eligibility, apply, or check coverage.
medicaid.detail: Eligibility and coverage rules vary by state.

samhsa.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
samhsa.description: Treatment referrals and information for mental health and substance use concerns. This is not counseling.
samhsa.detail: Free referral service, 24/7, in English and Spanish. Treatment costs vary.

treatment.name: FindTreatment.gov
treatment.description: Search for mental health and substance use treatment providers.
treatment.detail: Ask providers about costs, insurance, eligibility and openings.

aa.name: Alcoholics Anonymous
aa.description: Peer recovery support for people concerned about their drinking.
aa.detail: Peer support; not a medical treatment service.

na.name: Narcotics Anonymous
na.description: Peer recovery support for people experiencing drug addiction.
na.detail: Peer support; not a medical treatment service.

veterans.name: Veterans Crisis Line
veterans.description: Crisis support for veterans, service members and people who support them. VA enrollment is not required.

vso.name: VA-accredited representatives
vso.description: Learn how to find an accredited representative for a VA benefit claim.
vso.detail: Accredited VSO claims help is free. Attorneys and claims agents may charge fees.

fema.name: FEMA disaster assistance
fema.description: Official eligibility and application guidance after a declared disaster.
fema.linkLabel: How to apply for disaster assistance
fema.detail: Help depends on the disaster declaration and your eligibility.

redcross.name: American Red Cross
redcross.description: Find disaster support, open shelters and your local Red Cross.
redcross.detail: Check current local availability; this is not a shelter reservation.

lsc.name: Civil legal aid
lsc.description: Find a local LSC-funded legal aid organization for a civil legal problem.
lsc.detail: For people who meet local eligibility requirements. Availability varies.

aba.name: American Bar Association legal-help finder
aba.description: Explore legal aid and lawyer-referral options in your state.
aba.detail: Includes both free legal aid and paid lawyer referrals; ask about fees.

eldercare.name: Eldercare Locator
eldercare.description: Find local services for older adults and family caregivers.
eldercare.detail: Ask local providers about service costs and eligibility.

elderfraud.name: National Elder Fraud Hotline
elderfraud.description: Help reporting financial fraud against someone age 60 or older.

grief.name: GriefShare
grief.description: Christian grief support groups for people grieving a death.
grief.detail: Group or workbook fees may apply; check with the host.

hope.name: Alliance of Hope
hope.description: Information and support resources for people bereaved by suicide.
hope.detail: Check any service’s fees before booking. For immediate crisis support, use 988.

childcare.name: Child Care Aware of America
childcare.description: Find your local child care resource agency and state assistance information.
childcare.detail: Child care costs and assistance eligibility vary. This link is for families generally.

headstart.name: Head Start & Early Head Start
headstart.description: Find local early-childhood programs and ask about enrollment.
headstart.detail: Contact the program about eligibility and available places.

ssdi.name: Social Security Disability Insurance
ssdi.description: Official information about disability benefits and how to apply.
ssdi.detail: Social Security determines eligibility; this is separate from SSI.

ssi.name: Supplemental Security Income
ssi.description: Benefits information for people with limited income and resources who meet disability, blindness or age criteria.

ada.name: ADA National Network
ada.description: Ask about disability rights and accommodations under the ADA.
ada.detail: Information and guidance; not a promise of legal representation.

divorce.name: DivorceCare
divorce.description: Christian support groups for separation and divorce.
divorce.detail: Groups commonly charge a fee; check the group listing.

211.name: 211 local help
211.description: Get connected to local food, housing, utility and other community services.
211.detail: Texting options differ by location. Ask providers about eligibility and availability.

nyc-hope.name: NYC domestic violence support
nyc-hope.description: City guidance on shelter referrals and support for domestic and gender-based violence.

nyc-311.name: NYC 311
nyc-311.description: Find non-emergency city services and help navigating local resources.

nyc-benefits.name: ACCESS NYC
nyc-benefits.description: Explore city benefits and check what you may qualify for. Links to official applications, including ACCESS HRA.
nyc-benefits.detail: A screening is not an eligibility decision. Official applications may require an account.

nyc-food.name: Food Help NYC
nyc-food.description: Find food pantries and community kitchens through HRA’s food-help page.
nyc-food.detail: Call 311 for help locating food; confirm opening hours before going.

nyc-homebase.name: Homebase housing support
nyc-homebase.description: Homelessness prevention for New Yorkers at risk of losing housing.
nyc-homebase.detail: Call the local office before visiting to arrange an appointment. Eligibility applies.

nyc-shelter.name: NYC shelter information
nyc-shelter.description: DHS guidance for families and single adults who need shelter.
nyc-shelter.detail: Intake routes depend on household type; use the official guidance or call 311.

trans-lifeline.name: Trans Lifeline
trans-lifeline.description: Peer support from trans operators for trans and questioning people. You do not need to be in crisis to call.
trans-lifeline.linkLabel: See hotline hours and support options
trans-lifeline.detail: Monday–Friday, 1pm–9pm Eastern. Scheduled closures and high call volumes may affect availability.

trevor-project.name: The Trevor Project
trevor-project.description: Crisis support for LGBTQ+ young people in the U.S. by phone, text, or online chat.
trevor-project.linkLabel: Chat with a counselor or learn what to expect
trevor-project.detail: Free service, 24/7. Message and data rates may apply.

lgbt-national.name: LGBT National Hotline
lgbt-national.description: Peer support and local resource referrals for LGBTQ+ people of all ages, including questions about coming out, relationships, and gender identity.
lgbt-national.linkLabel: See peer support and hotline information
lgbt-national.detail: Free service. Monday–Friday, 2pm–11pm; Saturday, noon–5pm Eastern.

nyc-center-tgnc.name: The Center — trans & gender nonconforming support
nyc-center-tgnc.description: Community groups and connections to health care, housing, benefits, and name-change support.
nyc-center-tgnc.detail: Check the program’s intake requirements and current schedule.

nyc-avp.name: NYC Anti-Violence Project
nyc-avp.description: Support for LGBTQ+ and HIV-affected survivors of hate violence, relationship abuse, sexual violence, and other violence in NYC.
nyc-avp.linkLabel: Find survivor support and legal services

nyc-callen-lorde.name: Callen-Lorde — trans health care
nyc-callen-lorde.description: Primary care, hormone care, and other trans health services, with care coordination and referrals.
nyc-callen-lorde.detail: Ask about new-patient intake, appointment availability, insurance, and costs.

nyc-lsnyc-lgbtq.name: Legal Services NYC — LGBTQ+ legal help
nyc-lsnyc-lgbtq.description: Free civil legal help, including discrimination, housing, name changes, and identity-document updates.
nyc-lsnyc-lgbtq.linkLabel: Get legal help and find LGBTQ+ rights resources
nyc-lsnyc-lgbtq.detail: Intake: Monday–Friday, 9:30am–4pm Eastern. Help depends on location and capacity.

retired.name: NeedyMeds
retired.reason: Could not inspect useful page content during review; replaced by reviewed RxAssist and HRSA links.

retired.name: LawHelp.org
retired.reason: Fetch errors during review; replaced with LSC and ABA official legal-help directories. This does not establish that the service is unavailable.

retired.name: DisasterAssistance.gov direct link
retired.reason: Direct fetch was access-blocked; replaced with reviewed USA.gov application guidance, which links to the official application.
